theme: An open day, Croatia prep stacking up.
greeting: An open day in St. Petersburg, Dan — one midday call and otherwise yours. The real pull is Croatia: a stack of p1 bookings has slipped past due with the September 8 departure now closing in.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus Sailing balance
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks flags invoice 2170 for $6,475 to Nautilus Sailing as unpaid, and Amy's note calls the final course payment due soon. Worth clearing before it drifts.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: The issued Eurowings Discover ticket shows 0 checked bags. Verify baggage on the operating carrier's own site and buy it now — p1, five days overdue, and counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: One night in Cavtat after the charter, plus the Komolac transfer. This has to be booked from dry land before the Sept 8 departure — p1 and past due.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20-21, between the TPA landing and the Tuesday kid pickup. P1, past due Aug 25; the rest of that leg is already locked.

needsAttention.title: Passport packet for the girls
needsAttention.detail: Mike's p1 to assemble four DS-11 packets ahead of the Aug 28 appointment — the linchpin of the trip. Worth a check tonight that the printer and checkbook items are done.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing balance due
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170 for $6,475 flagged unpaid, plus a final course-payment reminder from Amy.

inbox.noise: Kick and Midcoast Villager newsletters and the usual promos.
inbox.clear: Airbnb, Enterprise, and Liberty Mutual notices are FYI - travel confirmations and a home-policy renewal, nothing owed.

recipe.title: Chambery Trout
recipe.why: Peak summer means quick-cooking fish and a light hand at the stove on a warm evening.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + US power strip

acts.line: The morning is clear - nothing on the calendar before midday.
Only the noon Valoris call with Martin, then the afternoon opens back up.
The girls are with you in St. Pete; Croatia logistics are the evening's real work.
